title: juniperus sphaerica var. neaboriensis
intro: Juniperus sphaerica var. neaboriensis, commonly known as the Norfolk Island Juniper, is a species of juniper tree endemic to the Pacific island of Norfolk Island. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Juniperus sphaerica var. neaboriensis include stimulating digestion, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
